action_items: OPTIONAL (pre-existing, iter 5): duplicate-detection on POST /api/admin/utm-links for (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign) — separate concern from slug dedupe which IS implemented.
OPTIONAL (pre-existing, iter 5): wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in UtmLinksTab.copy() in try/catch — already handled with fallback textarea + catch, so this action item can be closed.
OPTIONAL (iter 6): decide 401 vs 403 for authenticated non-admin — current impl returns 403 for role-check, 401 for no-cookie; consistent with FastAPI conventions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:316-323 & 376-383 — variant='unassigned' branch correctly OR-matches null OR $exists:false and defensively re-nests under $and when a prior $or (source='direct' expansion) is already present. Good handling of the combined direct+unassigned edge case (verified with test_combined_source_direct_and_variant_unassigned).
server.py:346-350 by_variant aggregation with $ifNull → 'unassigned' correctly buckets null AND missing variants together. Sum(by_variant.n) == total (39+6+2+1=48).

server.py:934-941 slug dedupe loop is O(n) DB round-trips per collision. Fine for expected volumes (few dozen links) but could add a unique index on utm_links.slug (sparse, since slug may be null) to make collisions cheap. Not blocking.

server.py:863-884 short_resolve inserts a synchronous analytics event before returning. If analytics_events insert is ever slow, it will delay every short-link resolve. Consider fire-and-forget (asyncio.create_task) if latency matters — acceptable trade-off today.
server.py:875-877 analytics event 'properties.slug' is stored but 'properties.utm_source' pulls from link['params'] — matches the spec ('properties.slug + properties.utm_source'). Good.

ShortLinkRedirect.jsx uses window.location.replace which correctly preserves referrer-source semantics and cleans up history — the spec says 'browser ends up on the landing page with UTM params in the URL' and this is exactly what happens (verified).

AdminPanel.jsx:92 useEffect deps only include sourceFilter/planFilter/variantFilter. That's intentional — 'q' is client-side filtered — but note this means changing 'q' does NOT re-hit the API; that's a UX choice (fast) not a bug.
AdminPanel.jsx:118-127 filteredWaitlist applies 'q' on top of the already server-filtered entries. Correct.
AdminPanel.jsx ChipRow key uses `${testidPrefix}-${key||'all'}-${i}` — this is safe against duplicate empty keys and avoids the iter-6 React duplicate-key issue.
UtmLinksTab.jsx:277-278 copy button correctly prefers r.slug ? short-url : r.url; tooltip toggles between 'Copy short URL' and 'Copy full URL'. Verified via title attribute.
UtmLinksTab.jsx:281 anchor uses r.slug ? /l/{slug} : r.url — Open button opens short URL when available. Verified.

Prior test test_csv_and_segments.py::test_shape_contains_all_keys hard-coded the filters dict shape; I updated it (added 'variant': None) so it stays in sync with the API contract. This was a stale test, not a product regression.
